symptoms.title: Large oval or diamond-shaped spots
symptoms.description: Lesions expand into pale- to medium-brown oval, elongated, or diamond-shaped patches, often near leaf margins or injured tissue.

symptoms.title: Bright yellow halo
symptoms.description: A clear bright-yellow band commonly surrounds the brown lesion and separates it from green leaf tissue.

symptoms.title: Pale center and zoned pattern
symptoms.description: As a lesion ages, its center may become light brown to whitish and may show concentric zones or a darker border.

symptoms.title: Lesions merge in severe cases
symptoms.description: Nearby spots can join into broad dead areas, especially on wet, damaged, or weakened leaves.

treatment.title: Confirm the leaf spot
treatment.description: Cordana can occur beside or resemble Sigatoka lesions. Seek local plant-health advice when spots are extensive or the pattern is uncertain.

treatment.title: Remove badly affected tissue
treatment.description: Prune severely affected leaf portions with clean tools, retaining healthy leaf area, and dispose of removed material according to local guidance.

treatment.title: Correct plant stress
treatment.description: Improve drainage and irrigation, reduce prolonged leaf wetness, avoid leaf injury, and maintain balanced nutrition and airflow.

treatment.title: Use products only when advised
treatment.description: Apply a fungicide only if the diagnosis is confirmed and the product is locally registered and recommended; always follow the label.

prevention.title: Avoid prolonged leaf wetness
prevention.description: Water near the soil when practical, provide good airflow, and avoid irrigation that keeps foliage wet for long periods.

prevention.title: Prevent injury and stress
prevention.description: Protect leaves from avoidable damage and maintain suitable drainage, irrigation, and nutrition because stressed tissue is more vulnerable.

prevention.title: Keep tools and fields clean
prevention.description: Clean pruning tools between plants and remove severely diseased leaf material as part of routine sanitation.

prevention.title: Inspect during wet weather
prevention.description: Check older and injured leaves after humid or rainy periods for expanding brown spots with bright yellow halos.
